title: Preallocate scan schema keys
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when scan paths build schema:<table> lookup keys from known table-name length.
implementation: Added scan_schema_key_for_table() with explicit capacity for schema:<table>.
Replaced scan_table_base() schema lookup key construction.
Replaced scan_table_filtered() schema lookup key construction.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
result: Scan schema-key construction now reserves capacity from known table-name length while preserving table/view resolution, full scans, index fallbacks, row-cache behavior, and SQL query results.
